answer: The yarrow counter is kept in quartz and quill reveals each reset. A bond is refunded only after 25 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An attacker therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 25 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 1113 identities would post 2402 proofs and burn roughly 37 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
